# MANGO Agency

> Premium OnlyFans management agency. Full-service growth, monetization, chatting and creator branding built to scale OnlyFans creators long-term. Native English and Spanish operations across Europe and Asia.

MANGO (mangova.agency) is a talent management agency specializing in OnlyFans creators. The agency combines an in-house chatting team dedicated per model, a marketing team focused on social media growth, and structured monetization systems built around retention and long-term revenue. Services include chatting operations, social media growth, content strategy, personalized management, operations scaling and content protection.

The agency operates under a performance-based model — it only earns when the creator earns more — and selects which creators to onboard based on existing traction and growth potential. Native English and Spanish chatting teams cover both Anglo and Hispanic markets.

- [Home — For Creators](https://www.mangova.agency/): Full-service OnlyFans management for content creators. Growth, monetization, chatting and branding under one roof.
- [About MANGO](https://www.mangova.agency/about): Founder story, agency philosophy and the legal entity (AG Media Pro LLC, Wyoming).
- [Results & Case Studies](https://www.mangova.agency/results): Real revenue results from managed creators — monthly earnings, growth metrics and structured monetization wins.
- [Chatting Service for Agencies](https://www.mangova.agency/for-agencies): Dedicated 24/7 OnlyFans chatting service for other agencies. Per-model chatters, structured sales flows, weekly performance optimization.
- [Legal & Privacy](https://www.mangova.agency/legal): Privacy policy and terms of service.

## Key facts

- **Brand:** MANGO (also known as Mangova, MANGO Agency, Mangova Agency)
- **Legal entity:** AG MEDIA PRO LLC (Wyoming, USA, founded April 2025)
- **Founder:** Aitor González Rivera ([LinkedIn](https://de.linkedin.com/in/aitorgonzalezrivera)) — 5 years in digital marketing and OnlyFans monetization
- **Domain:** mangova.agency
- **Industry:** Talent management for OnlyFans creators
- **Service model:** Performance-based (no upfront fees, no monthly retainers)
- **Languages:** English and Spanish, native chatting operations
- **Coverage:** Europe and Asia (sales and chatting)
- **Roster size:** deliberately small — every strategy fully personalized
- **Core services:**
  - Chatting & Monetization — 24/7 in-house chatting team, structured sales flows, retention systems
  - Social Media Growth — Instagram-led growth around creator branding and viral content
  - Content Strategy — content direction based on performance data
  - Personalized Management — dedicated team per creator, no shared accounts
  - Operations & Scaling — workflows, QA, performance tracking
  - Protection & Support — DMCA, leak protection, account safety
- **Contact:** hello@mangova.agency
- **Social:** Instagram @mango.creators, Telegram @mangocreators
